title: 🚀 One-Tap Access to DevDuo Developer Page!
message: We've added a quick way for you to explore our entire collection of apps and games directly on the Google Play Store.
points: 🌐 Direct Play Store Button: Tap 'Go to Play Store Page' in the Software Hub to easily view all official apps built by DevDuo.
🎨 Sleek & Compact Layout: Improved the button design so it looks clean, modern, and easy to tap.
⚡ Experience Enhancements: General bug fixes and smooth UI performance updates across the app.

title: ✨ Explore DevDuo Apps & Experience Improvements!
message: We are excited to introduce our new DevDuo Software Hub alongside smooth performance optimizations and dynamic system updates.
points: 🌐 DevDuo Software Hub: Explore all apps and games created by DevDuo directly from your Profile screen or update dialogs.
🚀 Discover New Tools: Filter apps by categories, view preview screenshots, and easily jump to the Play Store with one tap.
📱 Dynamic App Versioning: SafeKey now automatically displays your exact app build version dynamically without manual hardcoding.
⚡ Visual & Performance Polish: Fine-tuned UI spacing, card layouts, and background animations for a cleaner, faster vault experience.

title: ⚡ Re-Engineered Fluid Lists & Performance!
message: Enjoy an exceptionally smooth secure experience with our overhauled list framework, smart resource management updates, and network-independent fail-safe gates.
points: ⚡ Stutter-Free List Scrolling: Completely optimized our underlying list widget data trees to guarantee flawless, hyper-responsive scrolling speed across deeply stacked local vault directories.
🛡️ Strict Recycle Bin Limits: Reinforced free-tier validation rules inside the restoration pipelines to immediately detect and lock out account usage limit bypass loops.

📶 Offline Ad Fail-Safe Gates: Transitioned our interstitial ad presentation layers to an store-compliant framework—ensuring zero interface lockouts or blocking alert loops when you are completely offline.
🚀 Fluid App Transitions: Patched micro-stutters and layout execution redraw delays across our tab bars, giving the overall platform a lighter, faster, and incredibly premium performance feel.

title: 📷 HD QR Sharing & Notes Vault!
message: Experience pristine offline portability with our brand-new high-resolution QR scanning framework and unified secure notes transmission engine.
points: 📷 Full HD Portrait Export: Generate crystal-clear uncompressed QR images keeping high-density pixel code matrices exceptionally sharp for instant readability.
📝 Unified Notes Sharing: Seamlessly share secure notes alongside your passwords and credit cards using protective multi-tier GZip compression and custom one-time unlock PINs.
🚀 Gallery Scanner Framework: Re-engineered the album image picker code using an optimized scanning engine to completely solve file parsing issues or distortions caused by gallery image uploads.
🛡️ Local Cryptographic Safety: Data translation bundles are strictly encrypted directly on your hardware block—ensuring sensitive credentials never leak or leave your screen.

title: ⚡ Instant Launch Configuration!
message: Take control of your startup experience with our brand-new splash animation preferences.
points: 🚀 Bypassed Boot Delays: Disable the introductory splash screen logo inside your Profile Settings to access your passwords instantly.
🎬 Layout Preferences: Toggle the video intro back on or off anytime to customize your startup experience.
⚡ Seamless Authentication: Background routine enhancements ensure your vault data initializes smoothly without causing blank layout pops.
🛡️ Stability Fixes: Patched subtle system asset lifecycles to guarantee a safe, crash-free app session.

title: 📦 Offline Vault Backups!
message: Take total control of your data with our new zero-knowledge offline backup system.
points: 🔐 Offline Generation: Export your encrypted vault securely without relying on cloud networks.
🖼️ Media Included: Package all your custom logos and image attachments perfectly into a single backup file.
⚡ Easy Restoration: Switch devices seamlessly by importing your backup package with just one tap.
🛡️ Military-Grade: Backups are heavily encrypted with standard AES algorithms for maximum security.

title: 🕰️ Welcome to Memory Lane!
message: Take a journey through your vault's history with our stunning new timeline feature.
points: 📜 Memory Lane: View a beautiful, chronological history of your Passwords, Cards, and Secure Notes.
✨ Premium Design: Enjoy sleek glassmorphism cards, glowing nodes, and smooth staggered animations.
⚙️ Under the Hood: Optimized our secure database to track your item history seamlessly.
🔒 Locked in Security: Fully integrated with your existing biometric and master key protections.

title: 🚀 The Update Hub is Here!
message: We've completely revamped how you discover new features and updates.
points: 🔔 Smart Alerts: Get notified about new versions directly inside the app.
📖 Interactive Changelog: See exactly what's new the moment you update.
🤫 Mute Option: Not ready to update? Mute alerts until the next release.
⚡ Smooth UI: Added a beautiful blur backdrop and sleek animations.
